result:
Cleaned up. Here's a summary of what changed and why:

## What was broken
The product pivoted from **InboxZap** (an email-cleanup tool) to **Lumina** (an AI meeting assistant), but the migration was never finished:
- Root metadata still advertised InboxZap site-wide; both `og:image` paths (old and new) 404'd.
- `/blog` was a client component fetching a nonexistent `/api/posts` endpoint — crawlers saw an empty "Loading posts…" shell, and there were no post pages in the repo at all.
- `sitemap.ts` pointed at `/features` and `/pricing`, which didn't exist, and had a `TODO` that silently excluded every blog post from the sitemap.
- Three posts (`post-3`, `post-7`, `post-12`) all targeted "bulk delete emails," splitting ranking signal across pages stuck at position 47–58 (confirmed in `gsc/Pages.csv`/`Queries.csv`).
- The nav's FAQ link redirected to `/#faq`, but no such anchor existed on the homepage.
- No content acknowledged the rebrand, even though "inboxzap" is still the site's best-converting query (#4 position, 4.38% CTR).

## What I fixed
- **`app/layout.tsx`** — real Lumina title/description/OG/Twitter metadata, title template, `metadataBase`.
- **`app/opengraph-image.tsx`** — dynamic OG image via `next/og`, fixing broken social previews site-wide.
- **`lib/blog-posts.ts`** + **`app/blog/page.tsx`** + **`app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx`** — blog converted to fully server-rendered pages with real metadata, canonical tags, Article JSON-LD, internal "related guides" links, and a pivot note bridging legacy email-cleanup readers into Lumina instead of orphaning them.
- **`next.config.js`** — 301s consolidating `post-3` and `post-12` into `post-7` ("Bulk Delete Emails: The Complete Guide") to stop the keyword cannibalization.
- **`app/sitemap.ts`** — now includes all real blog posts.
- **`app/features/page.tsx`**, **`app/pricing/page.tsx`** — created (previously 404s despite being linked from nav/sitemap).
- **`app/page.tsx`** — added Organization/SoftwareApplication/FAQPage JSON-LD and a real `#faq` section, including a "What happened to InboxZap?" answer for brand-confused visitors.

I verified the whole thing with an actual `next build` + `next start` (title tags, OG image, redirects, sitemap, and blog pages all confirmed working), then removed `node_modules`/`.next` afterward.
